verdict.rationale: First-party docs say AnythingLLM runs entirely on your computer with no accounts or API keys, and that documents never leave the device. Community users confirm offline use and a working Ollama setup, and the developer says local is the default with cloud LLM, embedder and vector-db use opt-in per component. Missing for 10: no evidence of LM Studio or vLLM backend support, no documented confirmation of llama.cpp integration (only a passing community mention), and no in-depth first-party docs on configuring local model backends.
